mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notes WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notes (user_id, title, content, tags, images, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{tags}, #{images}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE notes SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, tags = #{tags}, images = #{images}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
